title: imap: SASL PLAIN authzid silently ignored
description: SASL PLAIN format is authzid\0authcid\0passwd. The IMAP auth handler splits on NUL and uses index 1 as username and index 2 as password, silently ignoring authzid (index 0). RFC 4616 §2 requires the server to reject or honor authzid — ignoring it allows impersonation if authzid enforcement is ever expected.
